name: @evavo/art-studio
description: Governed art production system for game, digital and print assets.

scripts.dev:mcp:workspace-writer: pnpm run build:domain && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-studio-mcp build && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-studio-mcp start:workspace-writer
scripts.dev:worker: pnpm run build:domain && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-studio-worker start -- daemon
scripts.worker:once: pnpm run build:domain && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-studio-worker start -- once
scripts.worker:until-idle: pnpm run build:domain && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-studio-worker start -- until-idle
scripts.project-art:check: node scripts/check-project-art-workbench.mjs && node scripts/test-project-art-workbench.mjs && pnpm run project-art:workspace:mcp:check
scripts.game-art:campaign:check: node --check scripts/game-art-campaign/common.mjs && node --check scripts/game-art-campaign/compiler.mjs && node --check scripts/game-art-campaign/markdown.mjs && node --check scripts/game-art-campaign-planner.mjs && node --check scripts/game-art-campaign-planner-mcp.mjs && node --check scripts/game-art-campaign-planner.test.mjs && node --test scripts/game-art-campaign-planner.test.mjs
scripts.build:domain: pnpm --filter @evavo/art-contracts build && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-direction build && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-sprite-planner build && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-core build && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-repo-inspector build && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-quality build && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-finalizer build && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-media build && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-delivery-optimizer build && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-audio-delivery build && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-provider-canvas build && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-godot build && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-godot-sprite-effects build && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-artifacts build && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-providers build && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-selection build && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-sprite-family build && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-repair build && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-runtime build && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-book-runtime build && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-sprite-supervisor build
scripts.check: pnpm run toolchain:check:installed && pnpm run toolchain:test && pnpm run ci:media-tools:test && pnpm run brass:review:mcp:check && pnpm run brass:production:mcp:check && pnpm run reference-intelligence:check && pnpm run image-processing-recipes:check && pnpm run project-art:check && pnpm run project-art:intake:check && pnpm run project-art:review:check && pnpm run game-art:campaign:check && pnpm run pixel-font:check && pnpm run governed-workspace-handoff:check && pnpm run workspace-writer:check && pnpm run raw-art:production:check && pnpm run raw-art:production:test && pnpm run book:creative-direction:check && pnpm run provider:runtime-profile:check && pnpm run build:domain && pnpm run raw-art:provider-runtime:check && pnpm run raw-art:provider-admission:check && pnpm run raw-art:provider-execution:check && pnpm run raw-art:provider-review:check && pnpm run sharp-exact-runtime:test && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm run foundation:check && pnpm run foundation:delivery:check
scripts.workspace-writer: pnpm run build:domain && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-studio-cli build && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-studio-cli start:workspace --
scripts.media:check: pnpm --filter @evavo/art-delivery-optimizer test && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-audio-delivery test && pnpm --filter @evavo/art-godot-sprite-effects test
